calendarFaqs.q: Do Miami-Dade students get out early on Wednesdays?
calendarFaqs.a: On Wednesdays when school is in session, students in grades 2–5 at elementary schools and grades 2–8 at K–8 centers are released one hour early. Exact dismissal times vary by school.

calendarFaqs.q: When do students return after spring break?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring break runs March 22–26, 2027. Monday, March 29 is a teacher planning day, so students return Tuesday, March 30, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: Which M-DCPS calendar applies to my student?
calendarFaqs.a: This page covers the M-DCPS elementary and secondary calendar. Technical colleges, adult education programs, and juvenile justice education use separate official calendars.

calendarFaqs.q: How does M-DCPS handle calendar changes after hurricane closures?
calendarFaqs.a: M-DCPS announces school closures and any resulting makeup-day changes through official district notices. Check the district calendar page after a weather-related closure for the latest schedule.

calendarFaqs.q: When does the second semester begin?
calendarFaqs.a: The second semester begins Tuesday, January 19, 2027. Friday, January 15 is a teacher planning day, and Monday, January 18 is the Martin Luther King Jr. holiday.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the Miami-Dade ICS file update automatically?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The .ics file is a one-time import for Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, or Outlook. Check the official M-DCPS calendar page for later revisions.

calendarNotes: The 2026–27 Miami-Dade school year begins Thursday, August 13, 2026, and ends Thursday, June 3, 2027. The district’s official spring recess runs March 22–26. With the weekend before the recess and a teacher planning day on March 29, students have no classes for 10 consecutive calendar days, from Saturday, March 20 through Monday, March 29, and return Tuesday, March 30.
